name: MN Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年 MN Holdings 与 Founder Energy 的 MOU 延长两年至 2028 年 9 月，与 China State Construction Engineering (M) 的 MOU 于 2026 年 8 月到期失效。公司全年营收由 540.4 百万 MYR 增至 869.2 百万 MYR，净利润由 47.7 百万 MYR 增至 92.1 百万 MYR。
overview_en: This year MN Holdings extended its MOU with Founder Energy by two years to September 2028, while its MOU with China State Construction Engineering (M) expired in August 2026. Full-year revenue rose from MYR 540.4 million to MYR 869.2 million and net profit from MYR 47.7 million to MYR 92.1 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 子公司 MN Power Transmission 与 Founder Energy 的 MOU 延长两年，与 China State Construction Engineering (M) 的 MOU 到期失效。
segments.note_en: Subsidiary MN Power Transmission extended its MOU with Founder Energy by two years, while its MOU with China State Construction Engineering (M) expired.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: MN Power Transmission 与 Founder Energy 相互同意将 MOU 期限延长两年，自 2026 年 9 月 11 日起至 2028 年 9 月 10 日。
actions.text_en: MN Power Transmission and Founder Energy mutually agreed to extend the MOU term by two years, from 11 September 2026 to 10 September 2028.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: MN Power Transmission 与 China State Construction Engineering (M) 的 MOU 于 2026 年 8 月 6 日届满失效，期内无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The MOU between MN Power Transmission and China State Construction Engineering (M) expired on 6 August 2026 with no material developments during its term.
